scope.gate_semantics: All three environment variables present; values are not interpreted.
scope.linear_failure_policy: Log actual solve lambda and existing failure only; no fabricated candidate metrics.

formulas.componentwise: max_i |r_i|/(|A||delta|+|b|)_i; duplicate cross coefficients summed before absolute values
formulas.physical_equivalent: Aphys=T^-1 (Hhat+lambda I) T^-1; bphys=T^-1 bhat; delta_phys=T delta_hat; reconstructed from rounded scaled coefficients, not original normal
formulas.rho: (cost_before-cost_after)/current_coordinate_prediction, only with zero nonprojectable counts before AND after, positive finite prediction and finite decrease/ratio
formulas.zero_policy: Componentwise 0/0 rows contribute zero; zero overall normwise denominator and nonfinite quantities are unavailable with a reason.

memory_design.scratch: O(P + maximum track length): two 6P f64 vectors, local 3-row residual/denominator arrays, per-landmark BTreeMap for same-pose cross aggregation

fixed_policy_scope: The scaling/damping entries below apply only to scaled arms; legacy arms retain H+lambda I. All arms share the listed iteration budgets, tolerances, observation and calibration policy.

fixed_policy.scaled_system: (T H T + lambda I) delta_hat = -T b

findings.interpretation: Small componentwise backward error does not guarantee a safe nonlinear update or a forward-error bound. The scaled 1k rejects nine infeasible candidates and one negative-rho candidate despite small measured linear error. Main alternates ten capped solves at lambda 1e-4 with ten accepted solves at lambda 1e-3.
findings.next_experiment: Predeclared opt-in step-quality-adaptive damping, separately from PCG tolerance/restart changes; frozen 1k nonregression gate before larger runs. No GT-selected sweep.

quality_carryover.method: All three output model files are SHA256-identical to independently audited PR85 outputs; reuse their geometry, identity, support, calibration, anchor, connected-component and post-only GT metrics. No new GT scoring was run for these byte-identical outputs.

timing_scope: Serial local post-map BA only on a shared host, with no concurrent local compile or geometry audit during timed runs. Diagnostic ON times are not a mapper/native E2E speed claim. Atlas diagnostic executed once per component; scaled 1k ON repeated twice.
